steps.title: Inoculate sample into TPGY broth
steps.instruction: Weigh approximately 1 g of the environmental sample and add it to two sterile tubes containing preregenerated TPGY broth (pre‑generated by thermal deoxygenation or conditioning in anaerobic conditions).

steps.title: Pasteurise and incubate enrichment cultures
steps.instruction: Subject one of the two inoculated tubes to pasteurisation at 70 °C for 15 min, then place **both** tubes in an anaerobic jar or chamber and incubate at 30 °C or optionally 37 °C for 48 h under anaerobic conditions.

substeps.instruction: Check broth turbidity and gas production after incubation.

steps.title: Plate cultures on selective agar
steps.instruction: Using a sterile loop, withdraw about 10 µL of liquid culture from the bottom of each tube and streak it onto the surface of Willis‑Hobbs or FAA agar plates.

steps.title: Incubate agar plates and evaluate colonies
steps.instruction: Incubate the streaked agar plates anaerobically at 30 °C or optionally 37 °C for 48 h. After incubation, assess agar colour change and look for proteolytic (clear zones), lecythynolytic (precipitation zones), and lipolytic (pearl‑shining colonies) properties.

substeps.instruction: Select representative colonies for Gram staining and downstream molecular analyses.

steps.title: Perform Gram stain on isolates
steps.instruction: Prepare a thin film of each isolate on a clean glass slide with a sterile loop, air‑dry, and heat‑fix by passing the slide quickly through a flame (avoid overheating).

substeps.instruction: Flood slide with crystal (or gentian) violet for 60 seconds and rinse with water.
Flood with Gram’s iodine for 180 seconds and rinse with water.
Decolorize carefully with 95 % ethanol until the thinnest smear areas become colourless, then wash with water.
Flood with safranin (10 % fuchsine) for 60 seconds and wash with water.
Air‑dry or blot the slide with absorbent paper.

steps.title: Extract DNA from cultured isolates
steps.instruction: From a 24 h pure culture, suspend the isolate in 0.5–1 mL PBS or saline to a density of approximately 3.5 McFarland.

substeps.instruction: Immediately place the tubes on ice.
Dilute the resulting DNA solution ten‑fold before PCR.

steps.title: Set up 16S rDNA PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL PCR mixture containing 3 µL diluted DNA template, 2.5 µL 10× Taq buffer with KCl, MgCl₂ to a final concentration of 4 mM, dNTPs to 200 µM, and 1.25 U Taq polymerase (per 25 µL reaction).

substeps.instruction: Run 35 cycles of: 95 °C denaturation for 45 seconds, 55 °C annealing for 45 seconds, 72 °C extension for 1 minute.
